# GravelCalculator.ca

> Free online gravel calculator for Canada. Estimates the volume, weight (tonnage),
> cubic yards/metres and cost of gravel needed for driveways, patios, paths, gardens
> and drainage. Supports metric and imperial units and multiple gravel densities.

## Core formulas
- Volume = Area × Depth
- Weight (tonnes) = Volume (m³) × Density (t/m³)
- Cost = Weight (or volume) × Price per unit
- Typical gravel density ≈ 1.5 t/m³ (1500 kg/m³)

## Quick facts
- 1 tonne of typical gravel ≈ 0.67 m³ ≈ 0.87 cubic yards.
- 1 tonne at 5 cm (2 in) depth covers ≈ 13 m² (≈140 sq ft).
- Recommended depth: decorative/path 5 cm (2 in); patio base 10 cm (4 in); driveway 10–15 cm (4–6 in).
- Order 5–10% extra for compaction and settling.

## Gravel densities used
- Loose dry gravel: 1.52 t/m³
- Dry gravel 6–50 mm: 1.68 t/m³
- Wet gravel 6–50 mm: 2.00 t/m³
- Pea gravel: 1.79 t/m³
- Crushed stone / crusher run: 1.60 t/m³
- River rock: 1.44 t/m³

## Notes
Estimates are for material only and exclude labour, delivery and taxes. Actual
quantities vary with gravel type, particle size, moisture and compaction.
